allCopy: Two UUID boxes, no picker, and no validation until the server answers.
Charged against the pupil’s fee account.
Choose the pupil this invoice is for.
Validation lands on the field, on blur, before the request is made — not as a red alert above the dialog after a round trip.
A payment larger than the invoice is accepted; the surplus becomes credit on the family’s account.
